prompt: A classic rubber duck with warm amber finish placed on location in a wide ceremonial landscape evoking ancient heritage ruins. The duck sits in a meadow of olive-sage with golden-ochre highlights, framed by pale limestone ruins in the mid-ground and a near-black brown tree silhouette on the left counterweighting the composition. The sky occupies roughly 55-60 percent of the frame, fading from desaturated dusty rose at the top into a warm beige lower band. Hard key light from the upper right, soft rim along the left edge, lacquered specular highlights tracing the body crown. Subtle film grain, golden-hour grade, crushed midtones, lifted blacks. Front-facing, slightly elevated at 30 degrees. Plain oval pupils with no decorative glint. Seamless backdrop in warm beige tone, not warm amber finish, not tinted beyond the palette. Hushed, ceremonial, reverent mood, the duck as a small symbolic object within an ancient stage set.
